scheme_name: Schemes under Ministry of DoNER (North East)
overview: The Ministry of Development of North Eastern Region (MDoNER) implements various schemes for the socio-economic development of the North Eastern Region of India. These include infrastructure development, livelihood generation, and bridging sectoral gaps through initiatives like PM-DevINE, NESIDS, and Special Development Packages. The Ministry coordinates with central ministries, state governments, and implementing agencies to ensure effective execution of development projects.
geographic_scope: North Eastern Region (Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim, Tripura)
objectives: Accelerate socio-economic development of the North Eastern Region to achieve growth parity with the rest of the country
Ensure full utilization of 10% Gross Budget Support (GBS) and other budgetary resources for the North Eastern Region
Promote investment in the North Eastern Region from public, private, corporate, and multilateral sources
Develop infrastructure to mitigate connectivity and social sector deficits
Strengthen institutions and networks for livelihood, social services, skills, and capacity building
Monitor and evaluate ongoing projects through PQMs and TPTI for quality, timely completion, and sustainability
Facilitate inter-ministerial coordination for effective implementation of schemes
Support livelihood generation and skill development through targeted interventions
eligibility: State Governments of the eight North-Eastern States, Implementing Agencies/NGOs working on MDoNER-supported programmes, and Central Ministries/Departments are eligible to submit proposals under various schemes such as NESIDS, PM-DevINE, Special Development Packages, and Schemes of NEC. Proposals must be submitted in prescribed format with all supporting documents and clearances through the Purvottar Vikas Setu Portal.
benefits: Financial support for infrastructure projects, livelihood generation, and social development; technical assistance and capacity building; monitoring and evaluation mechanisms; grievance redressal; timely disbursement of funds; and support for project formulation and implementation through guidelines and portal-based submission.
financial_support: Financial support is provided as grants-in-aid for creation of capital assets and general grants-in-aid to State Governments and implementing agencies. Funds are released after approval by the Expenditure Finance Committee (EFC) or Ministry of Development of North Eastern Region, following submission of Detailed Project Reports (DPRs) and concept notes. Disbursement is linked to utilization certificates and progress reports as per scheme guidelines.
application_process: 1. Prepare complete proposal in prescribed format with required documents as per scheme guidelines (NESIDS, PM-DevINE, Special Development Packages, or Schemes of NEC). 2. Submit the proposal by the State Government through the Purvottar Vikas Setu Portal. 3. Undergo preliminary examination and circulation for comments (15 days). 4. Receive comments on Concept Note from Line Ministries/NITI Aayog (15 days). 5. Receive comments on Detailed Project Report (DPR) from Line Ministries/NITI Aayog (30 days). 6. Submit proposal for Expenditure Finance Committee (EIMC) consideration after inter-ministerial consultation (30 days). 7. Receive Minutes of EIMC meeting after conduct (15 days). 8. Obtain Administrative Approval and Financial Sanction (AFS) after all approvals and clearances (15 days). 9. Proceed with implementation by the implementing agency or State Government.
required_documents: Supporting documents as per scheme guidelines
Approval from State Level Executive Committee (SLEC)
deadlines: Rolling basis — proposals can be submitted throughout the year as per scheme guidelines and availability of funds.
implementing_agency: Ministry of Development of North Eastern Region
contact_details: Email: secydoner@nic.in | Phone: 011-21411140 | Address: Jodhpur Officers Hostel, Pandara Road, New Delhi-110003
caveats: Projects must adhere to approved cost estimates, timelines, and quality standards
Timely submission of Utilization Certificates and progress reports is mandatory
Field monitoring, inspections, and audits by MDoNER or authorized agencies must be facilitated
Environmental and social safeguards must be adopted during implementation
Proposals must be submitted through the Purvottar Vikas Setu Portal
Unspent amounts under 10% GBS are pooled under Non-Lapsable Central Pool of Resources (NLCPR)
